why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. Item 1: the builder brief does use a try/catch in loadConfig, but only to rethrow a richer error ("throw a new error ... with `{ cause: err }`"). It also says outright: "Do not take the issue's suggested fix of catching the error and returning `{}`... `loadConfig` must keep throwing." Nothing tells the builder to return a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts line 3 and column 3 "in any readable form (for example `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, col 3`)". It fails a run only when `bad config:`, the path, or the location is missing, not because wording or order differs. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
